newsitem.title: USA: Bristol-Myers to expand research staff.
newsitem.headline: Bristol-Myers to expand research staff.

text.p: Bristol-Myers Squibb Co said Wednesday that it plans to increase its research staff by about 2,000 people over the next five years and acquire a 433-acre research and office park in Hopewell Township, N.J. from Mobil Technology Co.

The company said headquarters for its Pharmaceutical Research Institute (PRI) will remain at its facility in Princeton, N.J., at which construction for additional laboratory space is planned to support the growth of R&D.

Bristol-Myers currently has 4,000 PRI employees worldwide and its pharmaceutical research and development spending is expected to reach $1.3 billion in 1997 out of a total corporate R&D investment of $1.5 billion.
Total company sales for 1996 were $15 billion, of which $8.7 billion were in pharmaceuticals.

The company's research activities in recent years have expanded to include a network of 30 biotechnology and other research alliances. The current research pipeline includes 40 compound projects in active development.
According to Mobil Corp, its Mobil Technology unit will sell the facility to Bristol-Myers for $41.7 million.
